name: gpt-oss
blurb: OpenAI's open-weight gpt-oss models are hosted by more providers in this catalog than any other family, which makes them the easiest way to run an OpenAI-authored model without an OpenAI account.
blurb_zh: gpt-oss 是 OpenAI 发布的开放权重模型，在本目录里被托管的服务商数量最多，也是最容易在没有 OpenAI 账号的情况下跑起 OpenAI 自家模型的一条路。

name: Llama
blurb: Meta's Llama models are the default general-purpose choice on most inference platforms, so the same model ID often appears at several providers with very different free-tier limits.
blurb_zh: Meta 的 Llama 系列是多数推理平台的默认通用选择，同一个模型 ID 常常出现在好几家服务商，但各家的免费额度差别很大。

name: Qwen
blurb: Alibaba's Qwen family covers general chat and coding variants, and it is the family most consistently offered by providers headquartered in mainland China.
blurb_zh: 阿里的 Qwen 系列同时覆盖通用对话与代码变体，也是中国大陆服务商提供得最稳定的一个系列。

name: DeepSeek
blurb: DeepSeek's V3 and R1 models are the most requested reasoning-capable open weights, and several providers list them on free or trial-credit tiers.
blurb_zh: DeepSeek 的 V3 与 R1 是被问得最多的开放权重推理模型，好几家服务商把它们放在免费层或赠送额度里。

name: Mistral
blurb: Mistral AI publishes both general models and the Codestral coding models; the free terms differ between Mistral's own API and the platforms that rehost the open weights.
blurb_zh: Mistral AI 同时发布通用模型和 Codestral 代码模型；Mistral 官方 API 的免费条款与转托管开放权重的平台并不一样。

name: GLM
blurb: Z.ai's GLM models show up both on the vendor's own free tier and on third-party platforms that host the open weights, which is the clearest case in this catalog of the same family costing nothing in two very different ways.
blurb_zh: Z.ai 的 GLM 系列既出现在厂商自己的免费层，也出现在托管其开放权重的第三方平台上——这是本目录里同一系列以两种完全不同方式免费的最清楚例子。

name: Kimi
blurb: Moonshot AI's Kimi models are long-context oriented, and access to them is split between Moonshot's own platform and gateways that resell the same model IDs.
blurb_zh: 月之暗面的 Kimi 系列以长上下文见长，获取途径分为 Moonshot 自家平台和转售同名模型 ID 的网关两类。
